description: Looks at shots with vision and works out a frame that keeps a subject in view for Wide, Square or Phone. A subject can be given ('the pool and the front door'), or left empty to frame each shot around its main subject. Returns a ready frame for each shot, which frame_shot accepts as frames; a shot where the subject can't be found, or that already shows it with the default framing, says so and gets no frame. Changes nothing. Suits any framing that depends on what is in the photo.

aspect.description: The version the frames are for.

photoIds.description: Shots to look at. Default: every shot in the video.

items.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

subject.description: What to keep in frame. Empty: the main subject of each shot.

name: find_framing
title: Find the framing
